question: For each FEMA disaster declaration in the last 24 months, how quickly do federal grant dollars flow into the affected state?

matches.note: F3 baseline context (not required for build).

internal_scan.verdict: All feeder DSes exist. This flow publishes a NEW velocity-scored view keyed on disasterNumber. Uses FEMA as the anchor and pulls fresh disaster data with 24mo window.

indicators.name: Post-decl 90d grant $

candidates.source: SLED Grants FY24 + FY25-26 DSes, filtered by (state, Start Date in [declarationDate, declarationDate+90d])

indicators.acceptance: Grant DSes cover the disaster window

candidates.source: Tableau windowed average on SLED grants

preference_order_rule: This build publishes only the FEMA-anchored disaster DS with disaster-focused enrichment. The grant-side joins happen at dashboard time to avoid tightly coupling four separate refresh cadences into one build.
gap_summary: Post-declaration grant attribution is TEMPORAL CORRELATION, not causal. Many grants flowing in the 90d window are unrelated program renewals; we cannot tag which grants are recovery-specific without a CFDA / HMGP program-code crosswalk.
